name: courtship_song_plausibility_v0
description: Basic biological-plausibility audit of the MaleCNS courtship-song V0 floating-point model.

constraints: aPN1-vPN1-pC1 is the reported labeled-line pathway for male courtship-song perception.
Male chaining is strongest near the conspecific 35-ms IPI.
vPN1 strongly responds at 35 ms and longer, with attenuation below 25 ms.
pC1 is band-pass: strong at 35-65 ms and reduced at 15-25 and 85-95 ms.
pC1 inactivation almost completely abolishes song-induced chaining.
Connectome-derived LIF modelling uses connectivity weights and presynaptic neurotransmitter identity.
The published sign convention treats acetylcholine as excitatory and GABA/glutamate as inhibitory.
In-silico silencing is a biologically interpretable validation experiment.
Absolute firing rates are not expected to be quantitatively accurate in this simple model class.
